a.text: I'll keep our agreement and operate this round. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, reaching 8 cells is a long shot. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can work it out together. I won't take early without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two generator rounds gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
